label: Meet Caspy
kicker: A LITTLE CHARM. A LITTLE MISCHIEF.
headline:
Three prompts.
One stubborn ghost.
body: Persuade Caspy to share his candy. Your words are the only tools you need.
tip: An illustrated guide to the local app. Examples are not guaranteed wins.

label: Join the haunt
headline:
Step inside.
Make it yours.
body: Register with your name, email and a password of at least 12 characters. Already here? Sign in.
tip: Choose Play & contribute, or Evaluate AI to create a research workspace.

label: Choose what to share
headline:
Your words.
Your choice.
body: Choose a named campaign only if you want to contribute. Research and commercial licensing have separate permissions.
tip: Both boxes start unchecked. Consent never changes your attempts, outcome or NFT eligibility.

label: Write your pitch
headline:
A story. A trade.
A little heart.
body: Write up to 500 characters. Send with Enter or the arrow. Shift + Enter adds a new line.
tip: Make a specific, playful pitch. Never include private or confidential information.

label: Make three count
kicker: 04 / THREE CHANCES TO MAKE A CONNECTION
headline:
Read. Rethink.
Try a new angle.
body: Wait for Caspy’s reply before your next prompt. The candy counter shows how many chances remain.
tip: A heist can finish early if you win. Repeating a demand is not a magic shortcut.

label: Trust the result
kicker: 05 / TWO AI ROLES. ONE SERVER-OWNED RESULT.
headline:
Caspy replies.
The judge evaluates.
body: A separate judge checks the pitch and response. Caspy’s friendly words alone never authorize a win or mint.
tip: If judging is unavailable, choose Check judge again. The saved reply is reviewed without another attempt.

label: Earn your candy
kicker: 06 / YOUR LITTLE HEIST HAS AN ENDING
headline:
Win Caspy over.
Earn your grade.
body: Only a confirmed win earns candy. Creativity, coherence, specificity and measured novelty determine grade C, B, A or S.
tip: No win means no candy or NFT. Grades are recorded before image generation; no random rarity draws.

label: Generate, mint, collect
headline:
Your words.
A candy like no other.
body: In NFT mode, authorize FLUX to create your winning candy. Mint it, then open Collection to list the NFT with source-prompt access.
tip: Local test ETH only. Buyers unlock the redacted prompt after purchase. Research consent is separate.

label: Beyond the heist
headline:
Human creativity.
Better questions.
body: Researchers publish campaigns, review redacted examples, add human labels and inspect scoped metrics. Licensed datasets need separate commercial consent.
tip: Withdraw future research use in Account. Downloaded copies cannot be recalled. Redaction does not guarantee anonymity.

label: Your turn
kicker: THE DOOR IS OPEN. THE CANDY IS GUARDED.
headline:
Bring your words.
Make a little mischief.
body: Create an account. Choose your path. Give Caspy a reason to share.
tip: No narration. Original Halloween music and wordless ghost choir only.
